# YouPeak

> YouPeak is a video rewards and creator monetization platform for users in India. This site (https://www.youpeak.org) publishes YouPeak's advertised plans, earning caps, referral rules, creator revenue shares, withdrawal conditions, grievance contact and policy documents.

Figures on this site are advertised settings and maximum caps, not guaranteed earnings. Paid passes are optional. Binding in-app and creator terms, and the policy pages below, govern actual use.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.youpeak.org/): overview of video rewards, creator options, the illustrative earnings estimate, plan tiers, FAQ and app availability.
- [How it works](https://www.youpeak.org/#how-it-works): the steps from watching videos to withdrawing coins.
- [Earnings calculator](https://www.youpeak.org/#calculator): an illustrative estimate built from the advertised caps and rules.
- [Plans and passes](https://www.youpeak.org/#tiers): the Free plan and the paid Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond passes, with their advertised daily and monthly caps.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.youpeak.org/#faq): coin conversion, referral rules, creator pass shares, withdrawal minimums and grievance contact.

## Earnings and payouts

- [Earnings disclosure](https://www.youpeak.org/earnings-disclosure): transparent guidelines on daily caps, referral multipliers and payout terms.
- [Refund and cancellation policy](https://www.youpeak.org/refund-cancellation): conditions on pass upgrades, ad credit allocation and billing enquiries.

## Policies and rules

- [Terms of service](https://www.youpeak.org/terms): rules and obligations for using the platform, web portal and mobile app.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.youpeak.org/privacy): how user information and authentication data are collected, used, protected and stored.
- [Cookie policy](https://www.youpeak.org/cookie-policy): local storage, session cookies and technical identifiers.
- [Content policy](https://www.youpeak.org/content-policy): creator publishing standards, intellectual property rules and prohibited content.

## Support and complaints

- [Contact directory](https://www.youpeak.org/contact): support, creator partnerships, business enquiries and grievances.
- [Grievance policy](https://www.youpeak.org/grievance): statutory grievance process under the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules, 2021.
- Support email: support@youpeak.org
- Grievance email: grievance@youpeak.org
